records.didacticAndScientificRationale: The supplied complete pH-scale is a second qualitative representation of the already assessed aqueous Arrhenius ion model. Classifying pH2/7/12 and linking acidic/alkaline to relative H3O+/OH− abundance directly probes behaviour in water, rather than adding a logarithmic calculation, titration or separate practical method. The fresh pH4 and dry-gas countercases require model limits rather than unexplained memorized scale values. The nine-name/formula and solution/species core remains mandatory and exact.
records.concreteCountercaseAndBoundary: Correct nine-name recall alone cannot pass: a learner who calls neutral water ion-free, identifies unknown pH4 as HCl, treats pH as concentration-independent intrinsic acid strength or applies aqueous pH to dry gas fails the same aqueous-model explanation. Conversely, inability to compute logarithms or run an indicator experiment is not assessed or falsely credited. At25C neutral pH7 is properly bounded; full <7/=7/>7 legend includes fractional values and no universal 0–14 truncation.
records.sourceSupportedPart: NI9/10 pH-scale qualitative acidic/neutral/alkaline classification and attribution to aqueous H+/H3O+ or OH−, refined to predominance rather than mere presence.
records.sourceRemaining: No neighbouring qualitative detection experiments, experimental planning, personally measured pH, entire NI unit or universal official nine-substance duty is completed.
records.descriptionFit: The unchanged description asks names/formulas and aqueous Arrhenius behaviour; this qualitative supplied-scale contextual observation is within that same explanation.
records.newRecallOrImageNeed: No new recall unit or image required: complete scale, temperature and reference data are supplied; old required name/formula memory remains separate and unchanged.

records.didacticAndScientificRationale: The same local route-selection routine now asks why the supplied segregation rule matters: copper contamination changes the material category of an otherwise unburdened salt/water fraction. Naming a supplied waste/risk-prevention principle supports that exact composition-and-rule justification, without adding a general Green Chemistry course or independent disposal procedure. This was already implicit in the unchanged W-1 contamination countercase; the new W-SL explicitly checks the source naming operator.
records.concreteCountercaseAndBoundary: Someone can match A→S and B→K by labels yet claim mixing is acceptable to save a container. That fails the same justified selection because composition and the local rule change. Conversely, correctly applying W-SL does not demonstrate safer solvent selection, all Green Chemistry principles, waste-free experimentation or actual compliant disposal. Total liquid volume need not decrease: the supported statement is avoiding extra copper-contaminated waste volume, not eliminating already existing waste. U is withholding for the teacher, never a collection stream guessed from clarity.

records.didacticAndScientificRationale: Coefficient scaling is fully given and explained as a representation of more of the same fixed-composition product. The learner interprets56:32,112:64 and168:96 all as7:4 and distinguishes scaled amounts from a changed species formula. This remains recognizing and describing fixed composition at simple sulfide formation. It adds no independent equation-derivation, valency, mole conversion or electron-balancing algorithm.
records.concreteCountercaseAndBoundary: A learner may balance arbitrary equations but still treat112:64 as a new Fe:S composition; that fails this goal. A learner may explain the supplied2Fe+2S→2FeS scale and invariant7:4 using the given legend without deriving any equation or mastering11bea. That is valid here and does not justify the rejected global prerequisite. Merely copying2 is insufficient: the explanation must distinguish amount scaling from subscripts and keep the CuO/FeS product-versus-excess duties.
records.sourceSupportedPart: Class9 actual p18 coefficient interpretation for the fully supplied reaction: doubled coefficients represent doubled corresponding amounts, while fixed product composition persists.
records.sourceRemaining: No derivation of formulas or equations, valency, complete stoichiometry/mol or every coefficient context is completed. This source names the interpretation operator; it does not universally mandate the whole authored constant-mass-ratio goal.
